boundary.start: Bun calls the dashboard command runner.
boundary.end: The runner returns the parsed result after process exit and closed output streams.
boundary.optionalEndWork: The duration variant also completes its observer before the timer stops.
boundary.note: The measurements time the complete command path. No internal component has a separate measured duration.

limits: Compare variants within one experiment. Different experiments use different host conditions.
The policy comparison measures dashboard reads. It does not measure the resident.
The concurrent effect combines the deadline wrapper and eight-read admission limit.
The concurrent worker can delay other reads while it computes output digests.
The concurrent experiment measures per-read duration, not browser throughput.
The dependency overlay remains an experiment.
These measurements do not establish a memory leak or the cause of the original incident.
